How many heartbeats a value stays fresh without a new one; then the place shows no recent data. 1 to 20. Empty: as it is (3 for a new channel).
A value outside the range is stored, marked, and used nowhere. Empty on a new channel: what the quantity can be.
In maintenance its values are stored, marked, and used nowhere; retired, they are not listened to.
